NXEO Privacy Policy

NXEO respects the privacy of visitors to its website, and in particular their rights regarding the automated processing of personal data. In this privacy policy we explain which data we collect, why, and how you can exercise your rights.

For more information about the protection of personal data, visit the website of the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens): autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl.

As long as you have not given consent for the use of cookies and other tracking systems on this website, we do not place analytical cookies on your device.

Article 1, legal provisions

Website: www.nxeo.io
Data controller: NXEO

Article 2, access to the website

Access to and use of the website is strictly personal. You may not use this website, or the data and information on it, for commercial, political or advertising purposes, and in particular not for unsolicited electronic offers.

Article 3, website content

All trademarks, images, texts, illustrations, videos, sounds and technical applications used on this website are protected by intellectual property rights. Any reproduction, repetition, use or modification without the prior written consent of the data controller is strictly prohibited.

Article 4, website management

For the proper management of the website, the operator may at any time:

  • suspend, interrupt or restrict access to all or part of the website for a particular category of visitors
  • remove information that may disrupt the operation of the website or that violates national or international law
  • make the website temporarily unavailable in order to carry out updates

Article 5, responsibilities

The operator is in no case responsible for faults or interruptions in the operation of the website. You are responsible for the way you connect to the website and for taking appropriate measures to protect your equipment and data.

Article 6, data collection

Your data is collected by NXEO and any external processors. Personal data is any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

The personal data collected on the website is mainly used to maintain our relationship with you and, where necessary, to process your requests.

Article 7, your rights

Under Article 13(2)(b) of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), everyone has the right to access, rectify or erase their personal data, to restrict processing, to object to processing and to data portability.

You can exercise these rights by contacting us at support@nxeo.io.

Each request must be accompanied by a copy of a valid proof of identity bearing your signature, and the address at which you can be reached. You will receive a response within 1 month of the request. Depending on the complexity and number of requests, this period may be extended by 2 months.

Article 8, processing of personal data

If a visitor is suspected of violating a law or regulation and the authorities require the personal data collected by the operator, this data will be provided to them following an explicit and reasoned request.

Article 9, commercial offers

You may receive commercial offers from the operator. If you no longer wish to receive them, send an email to support@nxeo.io.

Article 10, retention period

The data collected by the operator is used and stored for the period determined by law.

Article 11, job applications

If you apply through our website, we process the details you send us: your name, email address, phone number if you provide it, your message and your CV if you include one. We use these details only to assess your application and to contact you.

Your application arrives in our mailbox and is only read by the people involved in the selection. To send the email we use Brevo as a processor.

We keep your details until four weeks after the end of the procedure at the latest. With your consent we keep them for up to one year, so we can contact you if something suitable comes up later. You can withdraw that consent at any time. If you want us to delete your details sooner, email hello@nxeo.io.

Article 12, cookies

A cookie is a small text file placed on the hard drive of your device when you visit our website. When you visit our website, a banner appears with information about the use of cookies.

We only place cookies after you have actively given consent via the cookie banner. Your consent is valid for a period of twelve months. You can change your preference at any time via the cookie settings.

We use the following cookies on our website:

  • Functional cookies, such as session cookies to store your session information. These are always placed because they are necessary for the website to work.
  • Analytical cookies (Google Analytics), to understand how our website is used based on anonymous information about visitor numbers, popular pages and topics. We have enabled IP anonymisation so we cannot identify you personally. These cookies are only placed after you have given consent.

We do not use tracking cookies for advertising purposes.

For more information about using, managing and deleting cookies for each operating system, see: autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/cookies.

Article 13, applicable law

These terms are governed by Dutch law. The court of the place where the operator is established has exclusive jurisdiction over disputes about these terms, unless a statutory exception applies.

Article 14, contact

For questions, product information or information about the website, you can contact:

Damian Zoetemelk
support@nxeo.io
